title: Mekanism: Mekalights
description: One block. Full base lighting. Powered by Mekanism.
body:
# ⚡ MekaLights ⚡

**One block. Full base lighting. Powered by Mekanism.**

Stop torch-spamming your caves, factories and farms. Place one **MekaLight Block**, feed it Mekanism power, pick a shape, range and brightness — the machine floods the area with invisible, full-brightness light emitters. One block, up to a **48-block radius**, zero clutter.

> 🟢 **Actively developed** — balance and features may still change. 

---

##  Features

- 💡 **Five light shapes:**
  - 🌐 **Sphere** — full 3D volume, ideal for caves and big rooms
  - ⭕ **Disc** — flat layer for floors, fields and mob-proofing
  - 🔦 **Cone** — real spotlight: aperture 15°–90°, 6 aimable directions
  - 🛕 **Dome** — half-sphere, aimable up (dome) or down (bowl)
  - 🛢️ **Cylinder** — vertical column with adjustable height (4–32 blocks)
- 🔆 **Adjustable brightness** — dial the light intensity from dim to full
- ⚙️ **Clean Mekanism-style GUI** — shape side panel with pixel icons, range, brightness, aperture, direction, height and a live energy readout
- 🔋 **Mekanism energy** — consumption scales with range, brightness and shape; bigger, brighter lights ask for beefier cable lines. **Energy Upgrades** cut the cost
- 👻 **Invisible ghost emitters** — no collision, build right through them, cleaned up automatically when the machine is broken or unpowered
- 🛠 **Debug view (per machine)** — green wireframe outline of the configured area, works even before powering on. Perfect for planning
- 🔍 **Jade support** — status and energy usage on hover
- 🌐 **Multiplayer ready** — built and tested for servers

---

##  Getting Started

1. Craft the **MekaLight Block**
2. Place it and connect Mekanism cables
3. Right-click → pick shape, range, brightness and aim
4. Done — darkness gone

##  Requirements

**Minecraft 1.20.1** · **Forge** · **Mekanism 10.4+** · *Optional: Jade*

##  Roadmap

Colored lighting experiments · more upgrade interactions · additional shapes · GUI polish

---

**MekaLights — industrial-scale lighting for serious Mekanism bases.**
